# Junior Data Analyst - Contoso Retail

Contoso Retail is a Vancouver-based online retailer. We're an AI-first company that values curiosity.

## What you'll do
- Write SQL to answer questions from the marketing team
- Build and maintain dashboards in Power BI or Tableau
- Partner with stakeholders to define KPIs

## What we're looking for
- 1-2 years of experience with SQL (required)
- Experience with dbt is a strong asset
- Familiarity with Python for data analysis
- Nice to have: experience with A/B testing

Our stack: Snowflake, dbt, Looker.

You'll report to Priya Shah, Analytics Lead.

Contoso is an equal opportunity employer. Benefits include a health plan and remote Fridays.
